# TradeSystem

`world-system`

Defines the rules governing player-to-player trade. A trade is a two-party session: each side proposes what they give and want, either may counter-offer, and the exchange commits only when both accept. A broker fee is withheld from the goods a player receives, scaled by their commercial skill tier.

> Ground the EconomyIsPlayerDriven principle in concrete trade mechanics whose balance numbers live in the design bible

## Attributes

| Field | Type | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ----------- |
| feeSkill | string | Social skill whose tier sets the broker fee on player trades. Trade (commercial acumen) — not Diplomacy, which the fabric scopes to NPC factions only. |
| brokerFee | json | Skill tier → fraction of received goods withheld as a broker fee. Higher tier lowers the fee; a master trades tax-free. |

## Actions

### resolveExchange

Commit a trade whose two parties have both accepted

**Conditions:**
- The exchange transfers each party’s give into the counterparty’s inventory
- The receiving player’s goods are reduced by the broker fee for their feeSkill tier
- A trade with insufficient goods on either side fails without partial transfer
